data: You fire a powerful stream of high-speed water at creatures in a {shape}, 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the blast must make a {save}, taking {dice} {type} damage on a failure, and half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the save also are pushed back 10 feet and fall prone. This move saps you of energy, and may not activate it again until after the end of your next turn.
Startles all other Pokémon. User cannot act in the next turn.
All Pokemon must make a CHA Saving Throw against your Intimidation/Persuasion DC.
